def find_max(words):
    """
    Returns the word with the maximum number of unique characters.
    If multiple words have the same number of unique characters,
    returns the lexicographically smallest one.

    :param words: List of strings
    :return: String with maximum unique characters
    """
    max_unique = -1
    result_word = ""
    for word in words:
        unique_chars = set(word)
        if len(unique_chars) > max_unique:
            max_unique = len(unique_chars)
            result_word = word
        elif len(unique_chars) == max_unique:
            if word < result_word:
                result_word = word
    return result_word
